description: This is a Java source file for a Spring MVC Controller class named UserController. It manages user-related operations in an admin web interface, including listing users, creating, editing, deleting users, changing passwords, and password reset functionalities.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller handling admin user management operations such as listing, creating, editing, deleting, and password management for users.

methods.name: displayUsers
methods.description: Handles GET request to show the user list page in admin.

methods.name: pageUsers
methods.description: Handles POST request for fetching user list data in JSON format for pagination.

methods.name: displayChangePassword
methods.description: Displays the change password form for the authenticated user.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Processes POST request to change the user's password, validating current password and setting a new one.

methods.name: displayUserCreate
methods.description: Shows form for creating a new user.

methods.name: displayUserEdit
methods.description: Shows form for editing an existing user by ID.

methods.name: populateUserObjects
methods.description: Populates model attributes with user-related options like groups, stores, questions, and languages.

methods.name: displayUser
methods.description: Prepares user data for profile view, initializing default values if user is null.

methods.name: checkUserCode
methods.description: AJAX endpoint to verify if a username code already exists.

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Saves or updates a user, including validation, group assignment, and email notification.

methods.name: removeUser
methods.description: Deletes a user specified by ID, with security validation.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets menu context in the model for UI highlighting.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: AJAX endpoint to get security questions for username, initiating the password reset process.

methods.name: resetPasswordSecurityQtn
methods.description: Handles password reset after security questions are answered correctly, updating the password and emailing the user.
